# Mayfly – Elixir on AWS Lambda

> Mayfly is an open-source (MIT) AWS Lambda custom runtime for Elixir. Handler behaviour, mix release build, Erlang runtime layers, response streaming, Managed Instances, structured logs.

- Docs index (Markdown): https://elixir-aws-lambda.dev/docs/llms.txt
- Agent Skill: https://github.com/bmalum/mayfly/tree/main/skills/mayfly-elixir-lambda
- Source: https://github.com/bmalum/mayfly
- Layer ARNs: https://github.com/bmalum/mayfly/releases/tag/layers (Erlang runtime layers and the mayfly-shutdown extension layer)
- Roadmap and Durable Functions PR-FAQ: https://elixir-aws-lambda.dev/docs/roadmap
- Companion packages: https://github.com/bmalum/mayfly_plug (Plug/Phoenix), https://github.com/bmalum/mayfly_aws (Idempotency, DynamoDB, S3, SQS, SNS, SSM, Secrets Manager)
- Author: https://karrer.solutions
